card.name: Just before the drug name UNLOXCYT
card.fires_on: The word right before the drug name UNLOXCYT, such as discontinue, of, or with. It also fires before other UN- or EN- letter strings, like the B in BUN.

modes.label: Before UNLOXCYT
modes.description: A linking word or verb piece such as 'of', 'with' or 'continue' that comes just before UNLOXCYT.
modes.example: The recommended dosage<< of>> UNLOXCYT is 1

modes.label: Before UN/EN letters
modes.description: A letter that begins an abbreviation ending in UN or EN, such as BUN or TEN.
modes.example: DIMINISHING URINE OUTPUT AND A RISING<< B>>UN ARE INDICATIONS FOR DISCONT

card.writes: It suppresses UN-, ON- and EN- continuations, so it appears to hold back those letter strings as the next token.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the drug name UNLOXCYT, such as 'discontinue' or 'dosage of'.
